data.summary: Enforce per-account daily withdrawal limits to satisfy compliance team's new risk policy.

options.name: DB trigger check
options.summary: Enforce as a Postgres trigger on the transfers table at write time.
options.code:
CREATE TRIGGER check_limit
  BEFORE INSERT ON transfers
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_daily_cap();
options.whenToUse: When app-layer enforcement is unreliable across many entry points.

options.name: Service-layer guard
options.summary: Add a guard in the transfers service that checks today's total before allowing the write.
cons: Must remember on every code path
options.whenToUse: When you have a single chokepoint for the operation.

options.name: Async reconciliation
options.summary: Allow writes, then a background job flags accounts that exceed the cap retroactively.
options.whenToUse: When the limit is a soft signal, not a hard policy.

data.beforeMermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[validate amount] --> B[insert transfer]
  B --> C[emit event]
data.afterMermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[validate amount] --> B[lock account row]
  B --> C[sum today's withdrawals]
  C --> D{over limit?}
  D -- yes --> E[throw LimitExceeded]
  D -- no --> F[insert transfer]
  F --> G[emit event]

flowchart TD
  A[query transfers] --> B[filter today]
  B --> C[sum amount]

data.rule: Race condition between check and write
data.rationale: Without a row lock on the account, two concurrent withdrawals can both pass the cap check before either commits.
LimitExceeded is thrown but the route handler catches a generic Error and returns 500 instead of 429.

tour.title: Why this PR exists
tour.caption: Compliance asked for a per-account daily withdrawal cap. The change is a small backend feature scoped to a single ticket.

tour.title: What it touches
tour.caption: Three modules see edits: the transfers API, the new limits library, and the accounts DB layer. Audit and notify are unchanged.

tour.title: The decision
tour.caption: A service-layer guard won over a DB trigger and async reconciliation. The trigger is bypass-proof but invisible; reconciliation is too soft for compliance.

tour.title: The hot path
tour.caption: withdraw() picks up two new steps: lock the account row and sum today's transfers before allowing the insert.

tour.title: The new helper
tour.caption: sumToday() is brand-new — queries today's transfers for an account and returns the running total.

tour.title: The high-severity catch
tour.caption: Without the row lock, two concurrent withdrawals can both pass the cap check before either commits. This is the headline risk in the PR.

tour.title: The smaller catch
tour.caption: The route still wraps the typed LimitExceeded inside a generic 500. Easy fix — surface it as a 429.

tour.title: Total footprint
tour.caption: Three files, +84 / −12. Most of the addition is the new limits.ts module.
